title: Fine-grained KV influence timestamping and billing reconciliation
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Add a low-overhead span & metric layer that records per-lexeme/KV-cache influence signals (hit/miss, kv_latency_ms, prefetch_indicator, token_index) and correlates them with per-request billing attribution. Goal is to tie cache behaviour to per-token latency and unit-cost changes so PM/finance can reconcile billing anomalies and SREs can prioritize cache tunings.
acceptance_criteria: New trace spans emitted for token emission path with attributes: request_id, model_variant, seq_len, token_index, kv_cache_hit (boolean), kv_latency_ms, decode_latency_ms, kernel_latency_ms, batch_id
Batch-level aggregate metrics: kv_hit_rate_by_model, median_kv_latency_by_seq_bucket, per-token-latency-histograms with burst tags
Telemetry pipeline consumes the new spans and populates 'token-cost-reconciliation' dataset in house analytics within 24 hours
Grafana dashboard 'token-cost-reconciliation-v1' shows per-model cost delta driven by cache miss rate and matches spot-check CSV reconcilers for three sample customers
End-to-end tests replaying 10k recorded requests validate that cache-miss tokens are attributed consistently to billing rows (<=1% reconciliation variance)
implementation_plan: 1) Define span schema and OpenTelemetry attribute names (PR #1)
2) Add light-weight trace hooks in emission path (runtime hooks) guarded by feature flag
3) Emit detailed token-level payloads only for sampled requests and full metadata for cache-miss tokens
4) Wire spans to existing Kafka topic 'telemetry-token-spans' with avro schema
5) Extend metrics pipeline (Beam job) to join spans -> logs -> billing ledger and produce reconciliation rows
6) Create Grafana dashboard and alerts for kv-miss-driven cost increases
7) Gradual rollout: internal canary -> 5% customers -> 50% -> 100% with rollback plan
telemetry_schema_changes: Add otel span attributes: token_index, kv_cache_hit, kv_latency_ms, kv_evict_reason, prefetch_hint, emission_phase, model_variant, seq_bucket. Add kafka avro schema version 3 for telemetry-token-spans.
rollout_plan: Day 0: enable for internal traffic only and run ingestion pipeline to staging analytics
Day 2: enable for 5% production requests (sampling policy: all cache-miss tokens + 1% of cache-hits)
Monitor latency/ingestion cost and errors for 72h, then expand to 50%
Full enable after validation and billing reconciliation sanity checks
risks: Telemetry volume spike if sampling misconfigured, increasing Kafka and ingestion costs
Instrumentation overhead adding tail-latency if span creation is not optimized
Mismatch in join keys between spans and billing rows causing reconciliation gaps
Exposure of token-level content should be avoided in traces to meet privacy/compliance
mitigations: Implement zero-copy span attributes (ids, hashes) and avoid raw token text in traces
Enforce strict sampling: 100% capture for cache-miss tokens, 1% for cache-hit tokens by default
Limit span attribute cardinality (model_variant, seq_bucket) and use enums where possible
Add pipeline guard rails: per-topic retention throttle and cost alarms
testing: Unit tests for span attributes and schema validation
Synthetic workload that toggles cache hit rates to validate attribution delta
Integration test: Beam job runs locally against sample Kafka data and produces reconciliation CSV
Load test: enable on 5k rps in staging to measure ingestion/tail latency impact
QA checklist: verify Grafana panels, Service Level Objectives, and alert thresholds
